body:
Founder direction: 'redgarden was more about heroes this is more about the ecosystem... we need like a ton of shit happening on the board.' First real step toward spec-1's six-personality creep roster instead of uniform minion stat blocks. Swarmling targets weakest-HP hero in range (every other neutral in this engine picks nearest), lower HP, faster escalated march, visually distinct (bright acid-yellow-green vs base olive). Alternates within each camp wave so two visibly different creatures spawn together. build.sh + test_arena.sh clean, 1188 PASS, no regressions. Commit 753560f.

⚓ ☃
title: Swarmling: second camp-minion archetype with real distinct AI (weakest-target aggro, faster escalated march)
